sources.title: Comfy-Org/lotus — AICHINA.news | AI China News
sources.snippet: Comfy-Org / lotus Lotus is a high-performance diffusion-based model designed for rapid visual perception tasks, specifically depth estimation and surface normal prediction. It provides high-quality geometric outputs at a fraction of the computational cost of traditional diffusion-based estimators, making it suitable for real-time vision pipelines.
